rate_tree_compatibility.reason: MIG-seq is a reduced-representation marker dataset and is not the homologous Compositae1061 common-locus data required by the current branch-length compatibility tree contract.

current_decision.next_action: Recover the full conference abstract/poster or other lawful detailed study record to obtain sample counts, vouchers, results and accession statements. Search for reusable MIG-seq raw/genotype data. If no reusable homologous nuclear data are available, retain the existing plan for at least two verified voucher/flower-colour-linked Compositae1061-compatible individuals.

claim_boundary: The public institutional summary establishes that MIG-seq was used and lists the five study taxa. It does not expose enough result/sample/accession information to reconstruct the analysis, promote C. boninense to the common-locus branch-length tree, or infer its exact sister relationship.
